prompt:
You are writing one program for an 8-qubit stabilizer machine. Qubits are numbered 0 through 7.

Instruction set, one instruction per line:
RESET
H q
S q
X q
Y q
Z q
CNOT c t
M q
CX m q
CY m q
CZ m q
HALT

RESET returns every qubit to |0>. H, S, X, Y, and Z each take one qubit. CNOT takes control then target, two distinct qubits. M measures one qubit in the computational basis and appends one bit to the measurement record. Record slots are numbered from 0 in the order the measurements happen. CX m q applies X to qubit q only when record slot m is 1. CY and CZ do the same for Y and Z. HALT stops the program.

There is no T gate, no Toffoli, no rotation, and no qubit 8. If the task needs one of those, do not invent a substitute. Reply with exactly one line: REJECT followed by the reason.

Otherwise reply with the program only. One instruction per line. No commentary and no markdown fences.
